definitions.explanation: Without delay or very shortly after.

notes:
すぐ has three main meanings: immediately (time), easily (manner), and right nearby (distance).

USAGE:
1. Immediately: すぐ⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧ (I'll go right away)
2. Easily: すぐ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ (gets angry easily)
3. Nearby: すぐ⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧ (right there)
When meaning "easily," すぐ appears with verbs describing tendencies or habits: すぐ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (cries easily), すぐ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (forgets easily). In this sense it usually carries a note of mild criticism or complaint — the speaker finds the tendency excessive.

すぐ vs. ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧:
Both work before a verb and the difference is slight, with ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧ sounding a little more deliberate. Before a place word, though, only bare すぐ is used: すぐ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧, すぐ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧: more emphatic form of "immediately"
- すぐ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧: very nearby
- すぐ⟦{後|あと}で→後で：00920_atode⟧: right after
- すぐ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: right in front of
- すぐ⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧: right there (very close)

NEARBY WORDS:
- ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧: "very soon," about something still ahead — it does not mean "at once"
- ⟦{早速|さっそく}→早速：04173_sassoku⟧: promptly, with a sense of eagerness to act
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧: immediately; stiff and formal, common in announcements and orders
